## Tier definitions

- **E2E Verified** — a `scripts/test-*.sh` exercises this pair at the given scope + object type end-to-end.
- **Adapter-Compatible** — both profiles carry `migration_policy: bidirectional-reviewed` and the registry ships the required adapter, but no on-disk E2E fixture covers the pair yet.
- **Manual / Rebuild** — at least one profile is `manual-template`, `official-api-or-rebuild-checklist`, `manual-rebuild`, `source-only`, or otherwise non-automatic; emit rebuild checklists via the official API/UI.
